collection.description: An elderly fisher confesses a lifelong wish to learn pottery.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: An elderly fisher confesses that they have always wanted to learn pottery.

choices.label: Wait until the busy season ends

a.name: Answer A
a.text: Their first pots are crooked, and they adore them.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: The potter learns fishing knots while the elder learns clay work.

c.name: Answer C
c.text: The elder regrets postponing it and finally sets a firm date.
